title: the flag-selected reflection traversal adapters, one row per member
heading: ## Per-member rows: the class descriptor each of the flag-selected reflection traversal adapters loads (OPUS, 2026-10-03)
lead: The family `flag-selected reflection traversal adapters` (frontmatter: 11 members; {N} get a row here) shares one shape, stated here once and not repeated per row: `lea rcx, [X]`, then a call to the shared traversal `0063E2E0` with the flag in `r8b` normalised to 1 or 0. What differs from member to member is the class descriptor X its `lea rcx, [X]` loads (every load of it in the body names the same X). Each row anchors the first such `lea`, the member's distinguishing instruction, and states X and the class X describes. The class is read from the certified image: the static initialiser that does `lea rcx, [X]` and calls a descriptor-constructor wrapper, and that wrapper's `lea r8, [name]` before its one call to `00632D80`; every such initialiser must agree. {CHECK} re-derives every row and compares it with the committed {ROWS}. A member whose loads name more than one X, a descriptor not named by exactly one class, or a value that differs fails it. Two controls are refused: a swapped value and a moved anchor. Members that do not derive are listed in [`excluded.tsv`](../../_index/candidates/opus-ee-flag-selected-adapters-1003/excluded.tsv).
